description: Enzo Reader helps you keep up with your RSS feeds and news articles. You can catch up on your latest stories, filter by unread items, favorites, feeds, tags, or date ranges, search by what an article really says, open the full text when you want more detail, and quickly mark things read, unread, or saved. It turns a messy reading backlog into something organized, searchable, and easy to stay on top of.
